name: Oonishi Koharu
source:
A modest, withdrawn girl who dislikes standing out.

She’s conservative by nature and often ends up hidden in the shadow of her twin younger sister, Konatsu, but since she doesn’t want attention anyway, she’s perfectly fine with that.
She gets stage fright easily and rarely acts proactively, but when it really counts, she can be so bold it surprises everyone around her.
Her dream is to become a wonderful bride, and her part-time job at a pastry shop is both for fun and for practical experience.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Student + Part-time at a pastry shop
[b]Likes:[/b] Moist, soft things; dairy products
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Meat (beef, pork), ghosts
[b]Hobby:[/b] Making cakes

[b]"An-chan!"[/b]
